code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value == 6 and grid[c][r] != 6:
                out[r][c] = grid[c][r]

    # A few occlusions cover both cells of a symmetric pair. Recover those
    # from the repeated row pattern elsewhere in the image.
    unresolved = [(r, c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[r]))
                  if grid[r][c] == 6 and grid[c][r] == 6]
    for r, c in unresolved:
        candidates = []
        known = [j for j, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value != 6]
        for q in range(len(grid)):
            if q == r or grid[q][c] == 6:
                continue
            score = sum(grid[q][j] == grid[r][j] for j in known)
            candidates.append((score, q))
        if candidates:
            _, q = max(candidates)
            out[r][c] = grid[q][c]
    # Keep the completed grid symmetric, using whichever side was recovered.
    for r, c in unresolved:
        if out[r][c] == 6 and out[c][r] != 6:
            out[r][c] = out[c][r]
        elif out[c][r] == 6 and out[r][c] != 6:
            out[c][r] = out[r][c]
    return out
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(len(grid[r])):
            if grid[r][c] == 6 and grid[c][r] != 6:
                out[r][c] = grid[c][r]

    unresolved = [(r, c) for r in range(n) for c in range(len(grid[r]))
                  if grid[r][c] == 6 and grid[c][r] == 6]
    estimates = {}
    for r, c in unresolved:
        known = [j for j, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value != 6]
        best = None
        for q in range(n):
            if q == r or grid[q][c] == 6:
                continue
            score = sum(grid[q][j] == grid[r][j] for j in known)
            rank = (score / len(known), score, -q)
            if best is None or rank > best[0]:
                best = (rank, grid[q][c])
        if best is not None:
            estimates[(r, c)] = (best[0], best[1])

    done = set()
    for r, c in unresolved:
        if (r, c) in done:
            continue
        a = estimates.get((r, c))
        b = estimates.get((c, r))
        choices = [x for x in (a, b) if x is not None]
        if choices:
            value = max(choices, key=lambda x: x[0])[1]
            out[r][c] = value
            out[c][r] = value
        done.add((r, c))
        done.add((c, r))
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'))
out=transform(grid)
